biggest_catch: North Dakota–area credit union: branches in Kenmare, Stanley, Minot, Fargo and West Fargo, and the bonus requires $1,000 in qualifying direct deposits plus 12 debit card transactions within 60 days.
catches: Open a Star Rewards Checking Account between September 1, 2026 and November 30, 2026 using promo code 300.
Within 60 days of account opening: receive qualifying direct deposits totaling at least $1,000; enroll in eStatements; complete 12 debit card transactions.
The $300 is deposited directly into the new checking account once all requirements are met; account must be in good standing at the time of the deposit.

Not available to existing Town & Country checking account members or anyone whose checking account was closed within the previous 18 months; one bonus per SSN; one new-checking-account offer per 18-month period; one-time use only; cannot be combined with any other checking account promotion.
The value of the offer may be reported as taxable income on IRS Form 1099.
Terms, conditions and qualifications apply and are subject to change.
